$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFCY (AIP France, chart dated 2026-07-09): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Possible IFR operations.
Usable declared distances: RWY length reduced in order to have a clear strip of 60 m at THR 28 paved.
QFU 10: wet paved RWY operating limitation when windspeed is 20 kts coming from 180°.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
If wind SE to S more than 20 kt, risk of turbulence on final QFU 100°.
AEM NR 9189: see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM activity interferes with low height circuits.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Preferred QFU 280° due to IFR procedure and noise pollution.
TKOF RWY 28 paved: adapt minimum speed when manoeuvring on the turnaround area and move forward at least as far as the second white arrow.
After TKOF QFU 280°, continue RWY heading to avoid AEM zone, and start right hand turn at 500 ft AAL minimum.
Southern circuit reserved for home-based ACFT.
Low height circuits reserved for flights under instruction, minimum height 500 ft ASFC.
THR 28 not visible from holding points A and B, therefore caution advised for entering on RWY.
During parachute dropping activity, or in case of high traffic, carry out engine tests at apron, as far as possible, in order to limit TWY occupation time.
TWY B prohibited by night and reserved for ACFT with overall width of main landing gear less than 4.50 m.
No holding point on unpaved RWY: After LDG on unpaved RWY, stay along the edge of RWY on the South side, before crossing the paved RWY.
TWY B prohibited by night.
Aerobatics NR 6500: see AIP ENR 5.5 Parachuting NR 388: see AIP ENR 5.5
